label: lem:zero_deriv_constant
title: Zero derivative implies constant on an interval
statement: Let $a \le b$ and $G$ be continuous on $[a,b]$ with $\texttt{HasDerivAt}\; G\; 0\; x$ for all $x \in (a,b)$. Then $G(x) = G(a)$ for all $x \in [a,b]$.
proof: For $a < x \le b$, the MVT (Lemma~\ref{lem:mvt}) gives $c \in (a,x)$ with $0 = G'(c) = (G(x) - G(a))/(x - a)$, so $G(x) = G(a)$.
